title: Use movie shots as previs/reference material to provide to Seedance so it can…
content: Use movie shots as previs/reference material to provide to Seedance so it can emulate the cinematography and shot style you want.
tips: Use movie shots as previs/reference material to provide to Seedance so it can emulate the cinematography and shot style you want.
